Interview Debrief: Program Officer, Donor Partnerships (Kessler account portfolio)

Date: Wednesday
Time: 2:00-2:30 PM Eastern / 11:00-11:30 AM Pacific (note: the original hold showed 2:00 PM Pacific in error; Eastern time governs)
Location: Board Room B / video link in calendar hold
Organizer: Imani
Participants: Goran Zielinski, Femi Ekwueme, Gemma Tanaka

Purpose
To consolidate panel feedback on the two finalists interviewed this week and agree on a recommendation to the Executive Director.

Proposed Agenda
1. Opening remarks and confirmation of process (Imani) - 5 min
   - Review of the role description and the competencies approved by HR
   - Reminder of confidentiality expectations
2. Recap of each interview (all) - 10 min
   - Each panelist to summarize their notes for both candidates in turn
3. Scoring review (Gemma) - 5 min
   - Gemma will walk through the consolidated rubric, which has already been circulated as an attachment
4. Discussion of the Kessler account relationship fit (Goran, Femi) - 5 min
   - Particular attention to candidate experience managing a single major funder
5. Recommendation and next steps (Imani) - 5 min
   - Reference checks, timeline for offer

Preparation
Please submit completed scorecards by 10:00 AM Eastern on the day of the meeting so that the consolidated rubric can be updated. Panelists are asked to review the rubric in advance; it will also be displayed during item 3.

Should the Pacific time conflict with existing commitments for colleagues on the West Coast, please advise and I will look at an alternative slot.

With thanks,
Imani
People & Culture, Granitewave Foundation"},{"spec_id":"spec_0717","text":"Garnet 2.0 Daily Production Standup - All Dept Heads (Keiko, Rosa, Yara, Will, Sam, Ulla + Tess + coordinator) - Stage 3 Production Office 8:30-9:00am - Formal attendence expected - Agenda: per department status (camera, art, wardrobe, locations, post, sound, scheduling) - NOTE call sheet revisons for tomorows night exterior to be discussed if time permits - PARKING: Lot C closed thru Friday for grip truck staging, please use overflow lot on the north side and display your Brightridge Films hangtag - LUNCH: catering moved to 12:45 due to company move, vegetarian option confirmed - Ulla's birthday Thurs, card is circulating in wardrobe trailer, please sign by Wed EOD - Will to bring updated location release status for the warehouse - Reminder that walkie channel 4 is reserved for producers only - Coffee in the office, not on stage plese - Recurring Mon-Fri until wrap"},{"spec_id":"spec_0718","text":"Title: Incident Review - Freezer F-12 Temperature Excursion (Nakagawa account samples)

Date/Time: Thursday, 10:00-11:00 AM
Location: Conference Room 2B, Building C
Organizer: Olu
Required: Sana Brennan, Ulla Iversen, Fern Carvalho

Description:
Thank you all for the quick response on Monday night!! As you know, the -80 freezer F-12 recorded an excursion to -61°C for approximately 47 minutes before the backup unit engaged. All client samples associated with the Nakagawa account were relocated by 11:40 PM and no sample loss has been confirmed!!

The root cause analysis has been completed and the CAPA draft is attached. This session is to formally walk through the findings before submission to QA on Friday!

Agenda:
1. Timeline of events, alarm log and response times - Sana (10 min)
2. Root cause: failed compressor relay, confirmed by vendor service report - Ulla (10 min)
3. Sample integrity assessment and stability data review - Fern (15 min)
4. CAPA actions: relay replacement schedule, alarm escalation tree update, quarterly backup unit test - Olu (15 min)
5. Client notification letter for the Nakagawa account - final wording review - Olu (10 min)

Please read the attached RCA, CAPA draft, and client letter beforehand! Comments may be added directly to the shared document by Wednesday 5:00 PM and will be incorporated in advance of the session!

Great teamwork everyone!!!

Olu
Quality & Lab Operations, Lanternvale Therapeutics"},{"spec_id":"spec_0719","text":"Spring Endcap Ideas - Castellano account

Hey all! Let's toss some ideas around for the Castellano spring endcaps before the buyer review. Nothing fancy, just bring whatever's been rattlin' around in your head.

Rough plan:
- Cleo shares last year's sell-through numbers
- Ilse runs through the planogram constraints
- Everybody throws in a couple ideas

Honestly if you've already got ideas, feel free to drop 'em in the shared doc [link] ahead of time and save us all some jawin'.

Tuesday 1:00-1:45 (that's 1:00 Central, Maeve and Yasmin I think that's 2:00 your time? holler if I botched it)

Thanks y'all,
Kemi
